trace_gate.reason: The inherited R90 trace intentionally de-duplicates by (layer_name, num_prefills), so repeated c2 prefills are not logged. The remaining nine output outcomes cannot be paired with a request order.

interpretation: The intermittent stable alternate stream reproduced, but R103 cannot accept or reject request order as its discriminator because its required trace cardinality failed. The trace must log every pure-prefill invocation with an invocation counter before the correlation is rerun.
next_experiment: Use a diagnostic-only overlay that replaces the R90 seen-set with a per-(layer,num_prefills) invocation counter and records every pure-prefill call; repeat the unchanged ten c2 batches.
